The original form places the principal's details in the left column
and the attorney's details in the right column. The scanning software
read each horizontal line across both columns before moving to the
next line. The separate given-name and surname fields are preserved
above in that reading order.

The authority permits collection of the sealed record envelope after
comparison with the inventory. It does not permit the attorney to
alter the contents of the envelope or to acknowledge inspection of
documents that remain sealed at the collection point.

The custodian must provide a receipt stating the number of envelopes
released. Any discrepancy between the inventory and the physical
package must be recorded before removal. An unexplained blank field
must not be treated as an instruction to insert an estimated value.

The handling charge is GBP 28. The proposed collection date is
24 January 2027. Paragraph 4.2 governs the receipt and the retention
of the original authority.
